title: Sponsors
description: The people supporting this trip financially — the canonical place to manage each sponsor and their evidence.

empty.title: No sponsors yet
empty.description: If someone else will fund part or all of your trip, add them here. You can record their relationship, contribution, and evidence.

fundingNudge: Your funding source involves a sponsor, but none is added yet. Add at least one so their support can be documented.

editor.title: Edit {{name}}
editor.description: Record this sponsor's details and evidence. Changes save automatically.

basics.title: Basics
basics.description: Who is sponsoring you, and how you're related.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: How to reach the sponsor and where they live.

financial.title: Financial profile
financial.description: Recorded income and liquid assets — for your reference, never judged.

assets.title: Assets & investments
assets.description: Property, vehicles, and investments the sponsor holds.

expenses.title: Covered expenses
expenses.description: Which trip costs this sponsor will cover.

letters.title: Supporting letters
letters.description: The sponsorship letter and proof of relationship.

documents.title: Linked documents
documents.description: Associate this sponsor with their supporting documents. Documents are created and tracked in the Documents workspace.

review.title: Review
review.description: A summary of this sponsor's details and evidence.

fields.notesPlaceholder: Anything else worth recording about this sponsor

financial.hint: These figures are recorded for your own reference only. They are never scored, ranked, or judged as sufficient.

empty.title: No investments recorded
empty.description: Add stocks, funds, or other holdings if relevant.

empty.title: No assets recorded
empty.description: Add property, vehicles, or other owned assets if relevant.

expenses.description: Select the trip costs this sponsor will cover.

sponsorshipLetter.label: Sponsorship letter provided
sponsorshipLetter.help: A signed letter in which the sponsor commits to funding the trip.

proofOfRelationship.label: Proof of relationship provided
proofOfRelationship.help: A document establishing your relationship to the sponsor — often expected for family sponsors.

documents.description: Link existing sponsor-evidence documents to this sponsor. Linking only records an association — it never changes or creates the document.
documents.noneEligible: No other eligible documents to link.
documents.allLinked: All applicable sponsor evidence is linked.
documents.missingHint: This required document doesn't exist yet. Create it in the Documents workspace, then link it here.
documents.staleHint: This linked document no longer exists or is no longer sponsor evidence. Removing the link won't delete any document.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: This removes the sponsor record from your dossier. Linked documents are not deleted, but your finance and consistency status may change.
